title: All limits for constant scalar restriction
statement: For a completed coefficient field E and scheme W, restriction to constant scalars on strict towers preserves limits of the inverse-tower shape.

proof.text: Compute limits of sheaves of modules pointwise, use the module restriction-of-scalars functor, and transport the resulting limit cone through the constant-tower construction.
